summary: Navient filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting that its Board unanimously appointed Diane E. Offereins as a director effective September 24, 2026, upon the Nominations and Governance Committee's recommendation. The Board determined she qualifies as independent under Nasdaq Rule 5605(a)(2); she will serve on the Audit and Compensation and Human Resources Committees, participating in the standard non-employee director compensation program described in Navient's 2026 proxy. No Item 404(a) related transactions were disclosed. This is a routine board addition, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure, so it does not constitute a special situation.
